scope: The registered targets whose wrist camera the mount-side rule changes: the only ones where the mount_side variant differs from the baseline.
selection_rule: Apply blender_demo_scene.choose_camera_mount(rule='mirror_if_end_on', threshold 20 deg) at the recorded initial tool pose of every recorded registered target (14 targets); keep those it mirrors. It mirrors exactly two: tree0 8353 (10.4 deg default, 51.8 deg mirrored) and tree1 19264 (10.2 deg, 32.4 deg). Every other target's camera is byte-identical under the rule.
